questions.question: What does chapter 4 describe about Solomon's reign?
options: The building of the temple of the LORD
His officials and the prosperity of his kingdom
A long war against all of the surrounding nations
A famine that struck during his reign
questions.answer: His officials and the prosperity of his kingdom

questions.question: How great was Solomon's wisdom said to be?
options: Equal to that of the neighboring kings
Modest, like that of the kings before him
Hidden, known only to his closest advisers
Greater than all the people of the East and Egypt
questions.answer: Greater than all the people of the East and Egypt

questions.question: During Solomon's reign, Judah and Israel lived in safety, each under his own vine and fig tree.
Solomon's _____ surpassed that of all the wise men of the East.
Judah and Israel were as numerous as the _____ by the sea, eating, drinking, and happy.
